design.purpose: A small storage basket for one person's yarn, toys or a folded throw beside a sofa. Green forms the base and lower sides; blue forms the upper sides.

steps.c: Place both yarns, hook and scissors ready.
Chain 4 in green; slip stitch into ring.
Round 1: chain 1, work 6 single crochet in ring, join.
Round 2: work 2 single crochet in each stitch; 12 total, join.
Round 3: (sc, inc = 2 sc) repeat 6 times; 18 total.
Round 4: repeat (sc in 2, inc) 6 times; 24 total.
Round 5: repeat (sc in 3, inc) 6 times; 30 total.
Round 6: repeat (sc in 4, inc) 6 times; 36 total.
Round 7: back-loop-only sc in each stitch; 36 total, join.
Round 8: sc in each stitch in green; 36 total, join.
Pull blue loop through final green loop to change colour.
Cut green yarn, leaving a 10 cm tail.
Round 9: sc in each stitch in blue; 36 total, join.
Round 10: sc in each stitch in blue; 36 total, join.
Round 11: sc in each stitch in blue; 36 total, join.
Round 12: sc in each stitch in blue; 36 total, join.
Cut blue yarn, leaving a 15 cm tail.
Pull the 15 cm blue tail fully through loop.
With hook, weave both tails through nearby stitches inside basket.
Press base flat and shape sides upright by hand.
